name: io.github.fatterdev/ibis
title: Ibis Assistant
description: Living project memory for real codebases: typed team memory with git provenance, change forensics, log analysis and tickets over MCP. Runs as a local stdio child (`ibis -mode stdio`) or attaches to a shared personal runtime over Streamable HTTP; VS Code users can install it from the Ibis Assistant VSIX.

remotes.description: Personal daemon started with `ibis run` (loopback; shared between IDEs).
